Order.title: Order
Order.description: In-seat cinema concession order placed by a customer and sent to the canteen receiver.

ticketId.description: Short display ticket code shown to customer and canteen (e.g. EC-4821)

seat.description: Cinema seat identifier extracted from QR code or seat selector

items.description: Bounded list (1 to 10 entries) of ordered concession items with id, name, and quantity

itemCount.description: Total item quantity across all line items (1 to 200)

paymentMethod.description: Customer chosen payment method at seat

note.description: Optional special preparation instructions for the canteen

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when order was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when order was last updated

/orders/{orderId}.description: Real-time cinema concession orders created by the Customer App (sender) and received by the Canteen App (receiver).
